# 自然AI夹具；报告者作用域，创建同朝私有人物／头衔并临时借非首府县，不修改正式互动或概率。
# 借县和保护原任／男爵的状态由本夹具归还；不回滚观察期间人物自身的自然升迁或领属变化。
tca_test_bribery_natural_prepare_effect = {
    save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_reporter
    clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_people
    clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_observers
    clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_actors
    clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_borrowed
    clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_original_people
    clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_baronies
    clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_titles
    # 空无地天朝的附庸会被原生维护归入首府所在天朝；付款者留在真实中国，临时借县维持有地身份。
    # 观察期间不反复改领属。最高领主为真实报告者，仅用于只读排除观察。
    save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_emperor
    tca_test_bribery_natural_create_group_effect = { TARGET = tca_bribery_natural_thin TIER = 1 }
    tca_test_bribery_natural_create_group_effect = { TARGET = tca_bribery_natural_generous TIER = 2 }
    tca_test_bribery_natural_create_group_effect = { TARGET = tca_bribery_natural_lavish TIER = 3 }
    # 独立无地天朝只作为外朝反例，不承载自然AI付款者或受贿目标。
    tca_test_create_merit_interface_character_effect = { CHARACTER = tca_bribery_natural_foreign GOVERNMENT = celestial_government }
    scope:tca_bribery_natural_foreign = { set_merit_level = 1 save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_person }
    add_to_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_natural_people target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_person }
    create_dynamic_title = { tier = hegemony name = tca_test_arrest_office_name }
    scope:new_title = { save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_empire set_capital_county = root.capital_county set_landless_title = yes set_delete_on_destroy = yes }
    add_to_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_natural_titles target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_empire }
    create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = granted add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_grant }
    scope:tca_bribery_natural_empire = { change_title_holder = { holder = scope:tca_bribery_natural_foreign change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_grant } }
    resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_grant
    scope:tca_bribery_natural_foreign = {
        change_government = celestial_government
        if = { limit = { is_independent_ruler = yes } debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL prepare_foreign_independent=yes" }
        else = { debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL prepare_foreign_independent=no top=[THIS.Char.GetTopLiege.GetID]" }
    }
    set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_days value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_seen_1 value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_seen_2 value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_seen_3 value = 0 }
}

# 报告者作用域；TARGET输出本组受贿者，TIER仅设定人格／关系，不写报价选项。
# 每组八位富有的有地AI付款者，原生档位9及准备期直属关系提供正式目标权重；仍可能随机不发送。
tca_test_bribery_natural_create_group_effect = {
    tca_test_create_merit_interface_character_effect = { CHARACTER = $TARGET$ GOVERNMENT = celestial_government }
    scope:$TARGET$ = { set_merit_level = 1 remove_short_term_gold = gold add_gold = 75 save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_person }
    add_to_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_natural_people target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_person }
    add_to_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_natural_observers target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_person }
    create_dynamic_title = { tier = duchy name = tca_test_arrest_office_name }
    scope:new_title = { save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_duchy set_capital_county = root.capital_county set_landless_title = yes set_delete_on_destroy = yes }
    add_to_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_natural_titles target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_duchy }
    create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = granted add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_grant }
    scope:tca_bribery_natural_duchy = { change_title_holder = { holder = scope:$TARGET$ change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_grant } }
    resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_grant
    scope:$TARGET$ = {
        change_government = celestial_government
        create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = swear_fealty add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_fealty }
        change_liege = { liege = scope:tca_bribery_natural_emperor change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_fealty }
        resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_fealty
        set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_tier value = $TIER$ }
        # 通过既有正式上限接口准备高品级目标，第二日缓存生效后才设原生档位9。
        add_character_flag = tca_merit_active
        add_character_flag = tca_merit_grant_suppress
        set_variable = { name = tca_merit_approved_level value = 9 }
        tca_merit_refresh_cap_effect = yes
        # 正直但贪财的受贿者仍可能被关系或困境说动；主动兴趣为零，使本组三人只担当收款者。
        # 薄礼对象以负债取得最低档，沿用正式概率。
        add_trait = greedy add_trait = just
        if = { limit = { var:tca_bribery_natural_tier = 1 } remove_short_term_gold = gold remove_short_term_gold = 1000 }

    }
    set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_remaining value = 8 }
    while = {
        limit = { var:tca_bribery_natural_remaining > 0 }
        tca_test_create_merit_interface_character_effect = { CHARACTER = tca_bribery_natural_new_actor GOVERNMENT = celestial_government }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_natural_people target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_new_actor }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_natural_actors target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_new_actor }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_natural_observers target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_new_actor }
        scope:tca_bribery_natural_new_actor = {
            set_merit_level = 1 remove_short_term_gold = gold add_gold = 5000
            add_trait = ambitious add_trait = deceitful add_trait = arbitrary
            set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_target value = scope:$TARGET$ }
            set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_reporter value = scope:tca_bribery_natural_reporter }
            create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = swear_fealty add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_fealty }
            change_liege = { liege = scope:$TARGET$ change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_fealty }
            resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_fealty
            if = { limit = { scope:$TARGET$.var:tca_bribery_natural_tier = 1 } set_relation_best_friend = scope:$TARGET$ }
            else_if = { limit = { scope:$TARGET$.var:tca_bribery_natural_tier = 2 } set_relation_best_friend = scope:$TARGET$ }
        }
        # 原版test_opinion_modifier无monthly_change，支持固定期限与显式opinion数值；只给自建人物五年好感缓冲，
        # 抵御任命／契约产生的正常波动，不写正式接受评分或发送概率。
        scope:$TARGET$ = { add_opinion = { target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_new_actor modifier = test_opinion_modifier opinion = 300 years = 5 } }
        tca_test_bribery_natural_borrow_county_effect = yes
        change_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_remaining subtract = 1 }
    }
}

# 报告者作用域；向刚创建的付款者借一个真实非首府县，使原生AI使用有地角色路径。
# 只从至少仍有两县、持公国以上官署的原任借县；原任保留首府/主官职/领属，全部借用者与男爵受保护。
tca_test_bribery_natural_borrow_county_effect = {
    save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_bribery_natural_borrow_selected value = no }
    random_vassal_or_below = {
        limit = {
            is_alive = yes is_landed = yes government_has_flag = government_is_celestial
            highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
            NOT = { has_variable = tca_bribery_natural_target }
            any_held_title = { tier = tier_county is_landless_type_title = no count >= 2 }
            any_held_title = { tier = tier_county is_landless_type_title = no this != prev.capital_county NOT = { has_variable = tca_bribery_natural_old_holder } }
        }
        save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_old_person
        random_held_title = {
            limit = { tier = tier_county is_landless_type_title = no this != prev.capital_county NOT = { has_variable = tca_bribery_natural_old_holder } }
            save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_borrow_county
            save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_bribery_natural_borrow_selected value = yes }
            set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_old_holder value = holder }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { scope:tca_bribery_natural_borrow_selected = yes }
        scope:tca_bribery_natural_old_person = { tca_test_bribery_natural_snapshot_person_effect = yes }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_natural_borrowed target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_borrow_county }
        scope:tca_bribery_natural_borrow_county = {
            every_county_province = {
                limit = { exists = barony.holder }
                barony = {
                    set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_old_baron value = holder }
                    save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_borrow_barony
                    root = { add_to_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_natural_baronies target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_borrow_barony } }
                    holder = { tca_test_bribery_natural_snapshot_person_effect = yes }
                }
            }
        }
        create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = granted add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_borrow_change }
        scope:tca_bribery_natural_borrow_county = { change_title_holder = { holder = scope:tca_bribery_natural_new_actor change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_borrow_change take_baronies = no } }
        resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_borrow_change
        scope:tca_bribery_natural_new_actor = {
            change_government = celestial_government
            set_realm_capital = scope:tca_bribery_natural_borrow_county
            create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = swear_fealty add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_borrow_fealty }
            change_liege = { liege = var:tca_bribery_natural_target change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_borrow_fealty }
            resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_borrow_fealty
        }
    }
}

# 原人物作用域；仅首次快照，已有保护不取得所有权；原任不改人格、金币或原任官职。
tca_test_bribery_natural_snapshot_person_effect = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_original_tracked } }
        add_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_original_tracked
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = tca_test_death_protection } }
            add_trait = tca_test_death_protection
            add_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_protection_owned
        }
        # 不朽不能阻止人物池脚本剪枝；只对借用原人物临时加防剪枝标记。
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = ai_will_not_convert } }
            add_character_flag = ai_will_not_convert
            add_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_prune_protection_owned
        }
        save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_snapshot_person
        root = { add_to_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_natural_original_people target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_snapshot_person } }
    }
}

# 报告者作用域；县先随县治归还，再归还其他男爵，最后只撤除本例添加的保护。
# 原任一直保有主官职／首府；一年内自然升迁、改任和领属并非借县造成，不回滚这些自然状态。
# 任何一项恢复不符留失败flag，供用例清理后独立断言，绝不将归还失败算作通过。
tca_test_bribery_natural_return_counties_effect = {
    create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = granted add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_return_change }
    every_in_list = { variable = tca_bribery_natural_borrowed
        if = { limit = { var:tca_bribery_natural_old_holder = { is_alive = yes } }
            change_title_holder = { holder = var:tca_bribery_natural_old_holder change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_return_change take_baronies = no }
        }
        else = { debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL restore_failed=dead_county_owner" root = { add_character_flag = tca_test_tca_bribery_natural_test_case_failed add_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_restore_failed } }
    }
    resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_return_change
    create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = granted add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_return_baronies }
    every_in_list = { variable = tca_bribery_natural_baronies
        limit = { var:tca_bribery_natural_old_baron = { is_alive = yes } NOT = { holder = var:tca_bribery_natural_old_baron } }
        change_title_holder = { holder = var:tca_bribery_natural_old_baron change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_return_baronies }
    }
    resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_bribery_natural_return_baronies
    if = { limit = { any_in_list = { variable = tca_bribery_natural_original_people is_alive = no } }
        debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL restore_failed=dead_original_person"
        add_character_flag = tca_test_tca_bribery_natural_test_case_failed add_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_restore_failed
    }
    every_in_list = { variable = tca_bribery_natural_original_people
        limit = { is_alive = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_protection_owned } remove_trait = tca_test_death_protection remove_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_protection_owned }
        if = { limit = { has_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_prune_protection_owned }
            remove_character_flag = ai_will_not_convert
            remove_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_prune_protection_owned
        }
        remove_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_original_tracked
    }
    every_in_list = { variable = tca_bribery_natural_borrowed
        if = { limit = { NOT = { holder = var:tca_bribery_natural_old_holder } } debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL restore_failed=county title=[THIS.Title.GetKey]" root = { add_character_flag = tca_test_tca_bribery_natural_test_case_failed add_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_restore_failed } }
        remove_variable = tca_bribery_natural_old_holder
    }
    every_in_list = { variable = tca_bribery_natural_baronies
        if = { limit = { NOT = { holder = var:tca_bribery_natural_old_baron } } debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL restore_failed=barony title=[THIS.Title.GetKey]" root = { add_character_flag = tca_test_tca_bribery_natural_test_case_failed add_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_restore_failed } }
        remove_variable = tca_bribery_natural_old_baron
    }
    clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_borrowed
    clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_original_people
    clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_baronies
}

# 正式发送上下文；只有独立测试的自建付款者与指定收款者采集最低档。
# 将最低档保存在本次互动上下文，避免答复前收入、好感或其他成交改变预期。
tca_test_bribery_natural_capture_offer_effect = {
    if = { limit = {
        scope:actor = { debug_only = yes has_variable = tca_bribery_natural_reporter }
        scope:recipient = { has_variable = tca_bribery_natural_tier }
    }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_bribery_natural_offer_tier value = tca_bribery_cheapest_tier_value }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_bribery_natural_offer_quote value = tca_bribery_ai_price_value }
    }
}

# 正式回复上下文；报价复核后、原生支付前保存两方精确余额。
tca_test_bribery_natural_capture_balances_effect = {
    if = { limit = {
        exists = scope:tca_bribery_natural_offer_tier
        scope:actor = { has_variable = tca_bribery_natural_reporter }
    }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_bribery_natural_actor_gold_before value = scope:actor.gold }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_bribery_natural_recipient_gold_before value = scope:recipient.gold }
    }
}

# 正式回复上下文；同一事务内验证双边余额与发送时最低档，记录通过核验的收款人。
tca_test_bribery_natural_check_settlement_effect = {
    if = { limit = {
        exists = scope:tca_bribery_natural_offer_tier
        scope:actor = { has_variable = tca_bribery_natural_reporter }
    }
        scope:actor = {
            if = { limit = {
                scope:tca_bribery_natural_offer_tier > 0
                tca_bribery_selected_tier_value = scope:tca_bribery_natural_offer_tier
                scope:tca_bribery_quote = scope:tca_bribery_natural_offer_quote
                gold = { value = scope:tca_bribery_natural_actor_gold_before subtract = scope:tca_bribery_quote }
                scope:recipient = { gold = { value = scope:tca_bribery_natural_recipient_gold_before add = scope:tca_bribery_quote } }
            }
                add_to_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_natural_verified_payees target = scope:recipient }
                var:tca_bribery_natural_reporter = {
                    if = { limit = { scope:tca_bribery_natural_offer_tier = 1 } change_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_seen_1 add = 1 } }
                    else_if = { limit = { scope:tca_bribery_natural_offer_tier = 2 } change_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_seen_2 add = 1 } }
                    else = { change_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_seen_3 add = 1 } }
                }
                debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL settlement_verified actor=[THIS.Char.GetID]"
            }
            else = {
                debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL transaction_failed=settlement actor=[THIS.Char.GetID]"
                debug_log_scopes = yes
                var:tca_bribery_natural_reporter = {
                    add_character_flag = tca_test_tca_bribery_natural_test_case_failed
                    add_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_transaction_failed
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# 报告者作用域；每日验证正式成交留下的牵制和双向名单，以及最高领主和外朝排除。
tca_test_bribery_natural_observe_effect = {
    every_in_list = {
        variable = tca_bribery_natural_observers
        save_scope_as = actor
        tca_test_bribery_natural_observe_pair_effect = { TARGET = tca_bribery_natural_thin KEY = thin }
        tca_test_bribery_natural_observe_pair_effect = { TARGET = tca_bribery_natural_generous KEY = generous }
        tca_test_bribery_natural_observe_pair_effect = { TARGET = tca_bribery_natural_lavish KEY = lavish }
        if = { limit = { OR = {
            has_hook_of_type = { target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_emperor type = tca_bribery_hook }
            has_hook_of_type = { target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_foreign type = tca_bribery_hook }
            is_target_in_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_recent_partners target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_emperor }
            is_target_in_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_recent_partners target = scope:tca_bribery_natural_foreign }
        } } root = { add_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_exclusion_failed } }
    }
}

# 付款者作用域；TARGET为三位私有收款者之一，KEY隔离每对人物的一次性观察标记。
tca_test_bribery_natural_observe_pair_effect = {
    scope:$TARGET$ = { save_scope_as = recipient }
    if = { limit = {
        NOT = { has_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_observed_$KEY$ }
        OR = {
            is_target_in_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_recent_partners target = scope:recipient }
            is_target_in_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_natural_verified_payees target = scope:recipient }
        }
    }
        add_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_observed_$KEY$
        if = { limit = { NOT = {
            has_hook_of_type = { target = scope:recipient type = tca_bribery_hook }
            is_target_in_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_recent_partners target = scope:recipient }
            scope:recipient = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_recent_partners target = scope:actor } }
            is_target_in_variable_list = { name = tca_bribery_natural_verified_payees target = scope:recipient }
        } }
            debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL transaction_failed=receipt_or_relationship actor=[THIS.Char.GetID]"
            root = { add_character_flag = tca_test_tca_bribery_natural_test_case_failed add_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_transaction_failed }
        }
    }
}

# 报告者作用域；年度末只读记录真实人物状态，区分未发送与准备后领属／预算漂移。
# 不注入选项、不触发原生AI，事件上下文中的selected值不能当作AI发送时的选项证据。
tca_test_bribery_natural_diagnose_effect = {
    every_in_list = {
        variable = tca_bribery_natural_actors
        save_scope_as = actor
        var:tca_bribery_natural_target = { save_scope_as = recipient }
        set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_diag_interest value = tca_bribery_ai_interest_value }
        set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_diag_weight value = tca_bribery_ai_target_weight_value }
        set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_diag_cheapest value = tca_bribery_cheapest_tier_value }
        debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL final_actor id=[THIS.Char.GetID] gold=[THIS.Char.GetGold] top=[THIS.Char.GetTopLiege.GetID] liege=[THIS.Char.GetLiege.GetID] merit=[THIS.Char.GetMeritLevel] interest=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.Var('tca_bribery_natural_diag_interest').GetValue] weight=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.Var('tca_bribery_natural_diag_weight').GetValue] cheapest=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.Var('tca_bribery_natural_diag_cheapest').GetValue]"
        remove_variable = tca_bribery_natural_diag_interest
        remove_variable = tca_bribery_natural_diag_weight
        remove_variable = tca_bribery_natural_diag_cheapest
        if = { limit = { NOT = { top_liege = scope:tca_bribery_natural_emperor } } debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL final_drift=actor_top" }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { liege = scope:recipient } } debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL final_drift=actor_liege" }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { government_has_flag = government_is_celestial } } debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL final_drift=actor_government" }
        save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_diag_actor
        every_in_list = { variable = tca_bribery_recent_partners
            debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL final_actor_partner=[THIS.Char.GetID]"
            if = { limit = { scope:tca_bribery_natural_diag_actor = { has_hook_of_type = { target = prev type = tca_bribery_hook } } } debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL final_actor_partner_hook=present" }
        }
        scope:recipient = {
            set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_diag_price value = tca_bribery_base_price_value }
            set_variable = { name = tca_bribery_natural_diag_acceptance value = tca_bribery_acceptance_base_value }
            debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL final_recipient id=[THIS.Char.GetID] gold=[THIS.Char.GetGold] top=[THIS.Char.GetTopLiege.GetID] merit=[THIS.Char.GetMeritLevel] base_price=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.Var('tca_bribery_natural_diag_price').GetValue] acceptance=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.Var('tca_bribery_natural_diag_acceptance').GetValue]"
            if = { limit = { NOT = { top_liege = scope:tca_bribery_natural_emperor } } debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL final_drift=recipient_top" }
            if = { limit = { tca_bribery_recipient_trigger = no } debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL final_drift=recipient_eligibility" }
            every_in_list = { variable = tca_bribery_recent_partners debug_log = "TCA_BRIBERY_NATURAL final_recipient_partner=[THIS.Char.GetID]" }
            remove_variable = tca_bribery_natural_diag_price
            remove_variable = tca_bribery_natural_diag_acceptance
        }
    }
}

# 报告者作用域；清理仅作用于自建人口和头衔，保留正式成交证据到结果核对之后。
tca_test_bribery_natural_cleanup_effect = {
    tca_test_bribery_natural_return_counties_effect = yes
    every_in_list = { variable = tca_bribery_natural_titles save_scope_as = tca_bribery_natural_destroy_title root = { destroy_title = scope:tca_bribery_natural_destroy_title } }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = tca_bribery_natural_people
        remove_variable = tca_bribery_natural_reporter
        clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_verified_payees
        tca_test_cleanup_merit_probe_character_effect = yes
    }
    clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_titles
    clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_people
    clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_observers
    clear_variable_list = tca_bribery_natural_actors
    remove_variable = tca_bribery_natural_remaining
    remove_variable = tca_bribery_natural_days
    remove_variable = tca_bribery_natural_seen_1
    remove_variable = tca_bribery_natural_seen_2
    remove_variable = tca_bribery_natural_seen_3
    remove_character_flag = tca_bribery_natural_exclusion_failed
    save_scope_as = actor
}
